Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.flowassurance

Class NaphthenateModelFitting

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.flowassurance.NaphthenateModelFitting
public class NaphthenateModelFitting extends Object
Regression of NaphthenatePrecipitationModel parameters to laboratory or field measurements.

Each observation is one experiment: a model holding the conditions of the experiment (oil, water, pH or CO2 pressure, temperature), the kind of quantity that was measured, its value and its standard deviation. The selected parameters are adjusted by weighted non-linear least squares (Levenberg-Marquardt with a finite-difference Jacobian).

Which parameters the data can determine:

  • Acid content of the water versus pH without calcium determines the sum pKa + log P. Fit only one of the two; they are separately identifiable only when the data reach pH values where the water acid is mostly dissociated and the oil is depleted.
  • Calcium soap amounts or soap onset pH determine pKsp of the calcium soap, given pKa and log P.
  • ARN precipitated fraction or ARN onset pH determines pK of ARN.
  • The enthalpies need data at two or more temperatures.

    • addObservation

      public void addObservation(NaphthenatePrecipitationModel scenario, NaphthenateModelFitting.ObservationType type, double measured, double standardDeviation)
      Adds a measurement.
      Parameters:
      scenario - model with the conditions of the experiment; it is copied, and its parameter values are the starting point for parameters that are not fitted
      type - kind of measured quantity
      measured - measured value in the unit of the observation type
      standardDeviation - standard deviation of the measurement in the same unit, positive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the scenario or type is null or the standard deviation is not positive

    • calculate

      private double calculate(NaphthenateModelFitting.Observation observation, double[] values, boolean extrapolateOnset)
      Calculates the model value of one observation.
      Parameters:
      observation - observation to evaluate
      values - trial values of the fitted parameters
      extrapolateOnset - true to return a parameter-dependent value above pH 14 when the calcium soap onset is not reached, so that the search has a slope towards parameters that give an onset
      Returns:
      model value in the unit of the observation type, NaN when the model has no value

      Returns:

      private org.ejml.simple.SimpleMatrix jacobian(double[] values, double[] base)

    • solve

      public boolean solve()
      Runs the regression.
      Returns:
      true when the fit completed and the model gives a value for every observation; false when an observed quantity cannot be reproduced at all (for example an onset pH that the fitted model never reaches), in which case the result is not available and nothing can be applied
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no parameter is selected or there are fewer observations than parameters

    • calculateStandardErrors

      Calculates the standard errors of the fitted parameters from the covariance matrix.

      Returns:
      standard errors, NaN where the data do not determine a parameter
